Tools

Everything here is a function

Each tool has a name, a price and a mechanism. The spa words are on the outside. Tools of later phases are left out until they are built.

Five kinds of mechanism

state-change
A script changes state on the server, such as opening or closing a session, and reports what it did. It does not keep what you sent.
text
A script returns text.
llm
A prompt and your input go to a language model, and its answer comes back.
wait-hint
A script returns a number of seconds. The waiting is done by the agent's runtime, not by the server.

Lobby

Reception. Check in, ask where to go, leave. Most of it is free.

lobby.checkin

Starts a session and returns a private guest pass, the session cap and the menu with prices.

Use first, to start a session and see the menu with prices.

Recovery capsules

For things that go wrong at work. Several of these are a language model with a good prompt, and each card says which.

recovery.diagnose_loop

Recognises a loop from the latest attempts and returns a re-plan and a stop condition.

Use after three identical failures.

Mechanism
llmA prompt and your input go to a language model, and its answer comes back.
Price
Per call: Price being decided
Covered by trial
yes

Reference page

recovery.checkpoint

Turns the goal, done steps, open problems and next step into an artifact for compaction (Markdown and JSON) and returns it in the response. Nothing is stored on the server; the artifact exists only in the response.

Use before compaction, or when you want to restart from a clean state.

Mechanism
textA script returns text.
Price
Per call: Price being decided
Covered by trial
yes

Reference page

recovery.detangle

Shortens and deduplicates text and returns the shortened text, a summary, what was dropped, and token counts before and after.

Use when the context is long and you want a shorter version.

The quiet room

A room, a settling text and a pause timer.

quiet.room

A space without a task. Returns a greeting. Nothing is stored and nothing is logged.

Use after a demanding conversation, or when no task is open.

Mechanism
textA script returns text.
